_note: One record for every picture in src/static/images. Fill in where each picture came from (your own photo, a stock site, a licence you bought), the licence terms, and where the proof is kept (an invoice, a licence page URL, an email). Set status to "confirmed" only when you are sure the picture may be used commercially on this site. Amazon's Operating Agreement requires respecting third-party rights, so keep this list true. The build and `python3 build.py --check` list every picture that is not confirmed yet. Pictures made in ChatGPT carry the extra fields platform, creator, licence_page, date_added, commercial_use, page_section, original_file and ai_generated. Set status to "confirmed" once you have saved a dated copy of the generator's terms.
